register.labelZh: BITE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: bite at 可以描述動物咬向手、玩具、球或其他移動中的東西,但不一定真的咬中。；bite into 可以描述緊身衣領、繩子、肩帶或手挽緊緊壓着身體,令人感到疼痛。；bite back 表示憤怒地反駁;bite something back 則表示忍住眼淚、說話或其他反應。；bite something off 可以描述用牙齒咬下食物、線頭、膠牌或其他細小物件。
register.summaryEn: Bite at helps you describe an animal snapping at a hand, toy, ball or another moving object without necessarily making contact. Bite into can describe a tight collar, rope, strap or handle pressing painfully against the body. Bite back describes an angry reply, while bite something back describes stopping tears, words or another reaction. Bite something off is useful when talking about food, thread, tags and other small things removed with the teeth.
